privacy:
Metri Guard processes packaging images solely for automated compliance analysis under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009. 

1. Data Processing
Images uploaded by users are processed in memory and immediately discarded after the compliance audit is generated, unless explicitly opted-in for AI model training. 

2. Data Sharing
We do not share any vendor or package data with third parties. Findings generated by this tool are for decision support only and are strictly confidential between the authorized user and the system.
terms:
Metri Guard provides AI-driven decision-support tools for packaging compliance.

1. Disclaimer of Liability
Our automated findings do not constitute binding legal advice. All results, notices, and penalty references must be manually verified by an authorized Legal Metrology Officer before any enforcement action is taken.

2. Usage
By using this tool, you agree to upload only relevant packaging materials and to not use the system for unauthorized surveillance.

==================================================
OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT GUIDELINES & LAWS ENFORCED
==================================================

1. Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
Enforced by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution.
- Rule 6(1)(a): Name and Address of the Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer must be clearly visible.
- Rule 6(1)(b): Generic or common name of the commodity.
- Rule 6(1)(c): Net Quantity in standard units of weight, measure, or number.
- Rule 6(1)(d): Month and Year of Manufacture or Pre-packing or Import.
- Rule 6(1)(e): Maximum Retail Price (MRP) must be displayed inclusive of all taxes.
- Rule 6(1)(f): Consumer Care Details (Phone number, Email address, and physical address).

2. FSSAI (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
Enforced under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
- Regulation 5(3) & Schedule I: Mandatory Nutritional Information per 100g or 100ml. Must include Energy, Protein, Carbohydrate, Total Sugars, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, and Sodium.
- Regulation 4(3): Trans Fat and Saturated Fat must be declared even if their value is 0g.
- Regulation 5(14): Vegetarian and Non-Vegetarian logos must be prominently displayed near the product name.

3. How the AI Analyzes This Data
- Principal Display Panel (PDP) Scanning: YOLO object detection identifies zones like the MRP, Net Quantity, and Veg/Non-Veg logos.
- Spatial Verification: The AI checks if the text height meets the statutory minimums based on the PDP area calculated from the package dimensions.
- Nutritional Engine (Schedule I): Optical Character Recognition (OCR) extracts the back-panel text. The rules engine fuzzy-matches nutrient names (allowing for 50% OCR distortion) and verifies that every statutorily required nutrient is present and explicitly quantified.
